```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

Figure 4 and the supplementary figures of the cohort comparison (Figures S11-S18), on the REML curves of the
LoD trajectories of both cohorts (`resources/LoD/`, the 5 main genes only): the trajectories of both cohorts, the mixed
models of log10 VAF on age and cohort with the measured data (all trajectories and by cluster, the SardiNIA trajectories
assigned to the final consensus clusters by `03_consensus_clusters.Rmd`), the per-trajectory summary statistics
including the age at LoD/2 and at 2% VAF, the matching sets, the models with the interaction and by gene, and the summary
statistics of every set. The models with sex and smoking (`02_cohort_characteristics_sex_smoking.Rmd`) are reported
in the text.

```{r libraries}
source("R/paper_functions.R")
library(ggExtra)

sets <- set_names(set_keys) %>% map(~ read_set(.x, "5"))
ages <- bind_rows(load_ages(), load_sard_ages())
cl <- load_final_clusters(); cl_sard <- load_final_sard_clusters()
cl_all <- bind_rows(cl %>% select(traj_id, cluster, label), cl_sard %>% select(traj_id, cluster, label))
k_cl <- n_distinct(cl$cluster)
lab_map <- cluster_label_map(cl)
for (d in c(file.path(paper$figure(4), "panels"), file.path(paper$supp, "panels"), file.path(rev$figures, "panels"))) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
coef_saved_file <- file.path(rev$lod_results, "SHCS_Sardinia_mixed_models_coefficients.txt")   # optional check against an earlier version of the analysis
imap_dfr(sets, ~ .x %>% group_by(Cohort) %>% summarise(set = set_labels[[.y]], trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id), individuals = n_distinct(ID), `age range` = paste(range(Age), collapse = "-"), .groups = "drop")) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "The four sets, 5 main genes")
```

# 1. Figure 4a: all trajectories of both cohorts (unmatched set)

```{r fig4a, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
margin_plot <- function(d, size = 15, legend = TRUE) {
  n <- d %>% group_by(Cohort) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(traj_id), .groups = "drop")
  p <- d %>% group_by(traj_id) %>% filter(n() > 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("SardiNIA", "SHCS"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = VAF, color = Cohort, group = traj_id)) +
    geom_point(size = 0) + geom_line(alpha = 0.55, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, label = sprintf("SHCS, N=%d", n$n[n$Cohort == "SHCS"]), colour = "red3", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 3.2, label = sprintf("SardiNIA, N=%d", n$n[n$Cohort == "SardiNIA"]), colour = "grey44", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cohort_colors, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 0.41)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = size) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  ggMarginal(p, type = "density", margins = "x", groupColour = TRUE, groupFill = TRUE, size = 6)
}
p_5a <- margin_plot(sets$unmatched)
for (e in c("png", "svg")) ggsave(file.path(paper$figure(4), "panels", paste0("Fig4a_trajectories_both_cohorts.", e)), p_5a, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(p_5a)
```

# 2. Mixed models of log10 VAF on age and cohort

```{r mm}
datasets <- map(sets, ~ .x %>% filter(data_point == 1))
genes <- c("All", main_genes)
results <- list()
for (dn in names(datasets)) for (gene in genes) for (zero in c(TRUE, FALSE)) {
  label <- paste(dn, gene, "slope", if (zero) "zero" else "", sep = ".")
  results[[label]] <- fit_cohort_model(datasets[[dn]], gene == "All" | Gene == gene, random_slope = TRUE, zero = zero)
}
coef_all <- all_cohort_coefficients(results)
if (file.exists(coef_saved_file)) {
  coef_saved <- read_tsv_(coef_saved_file)
  chk <- inner_join(coef_all %>% filter(Term %in% c("Age", "HIV", "Age:HIV")), coef_saved %>% filter(Term %in% c("Age", "HIV", "Age:HIV")), by = c("label", "Term"), suffix = c("", ".saved"))
  stopifnot(nrow(chk) > 0, max(abs(chk$Estimate - chk$Estimate.saved)) < 1e-4)
}
results_cl <- list()
for (dn in names(datasets)) for (k in seq_len(k_cl)) {
  d <- datasets[[dn]] %>% inner_join(cl_all %>% select(traj_id, cluster), by = "traj_id")
  results_cl[[paste(dn, k, sep = ".")]] <- fit_cohort_model(d, cluster == k, random_slope = TRUE, zero = TRUE)
}
coef_cl <- all_cohort_coefficients(results_cl)
write_res(bind_rows(coef_all %>% mutate(level = "all / gene"), coef_cl %>% mutate(level = "cluster")), "fig4_mixed_models_coefficients.txt")
hiv_tab <- bind_rows(coef_all %>% filter(grepl("slope.zero$", label)) %>% mutate(group = sub("^[a-z_]+\\.([A-Za-z0-9]+)\\..*", "\\1", label)),
                     coef_cl %>% mutate(group = paste(lab_map[sub("^[a-z_]+\\.([0-9])$", "\\1", label)], "cluster"))) %>%
  filter(Term == "HIV") %>%
  mutate(set = factor(sub("\\..*", "", label), levels = set_keys, labels = set_labels[set_keys]),
         cell = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f), p = %s; n = %d", Estimate, `CI Lower`, `CI Upper`, fmt_p(`p-value`), trajectories)) %>%
  select(set, group, cell) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = set, values_from = cell)
knitr::kable(hiv_tab, caption = "HIV effect on log10 VAF (random slope, no interaction)")
knitr::kable(coef_all %>% filter(grepl("All.slope.$", label), Term == "Age:HIV") %>% select(label, Estimate, `CI Lower`, `CI Upper`, `p-value`), digits = 4, caption = "Age x HIV interaction")
knitr::kable(bind_rows(cl %>% mutate(Cohort = "SHCS"), cl_sard %>% mutate(Cohort = "SardiNIA")) %>% filter(traj_id %in% datasets$unmatched$traj_id) %>%
               count(Cohort, cluster, label) %>% group_by(Cohort) %>% mutate(share = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * n / sum(n))), caption = "Clusters by cohort (unmatched set, 5 genes)")
```

```{r fig4b-clusters, fig.width=16, fig.height=5}
p_5b <- cohort_model_panel(results[["unmatched.All.slope.zero"]])
p_cl <- map(seq_len(k_cl), function(k) {
  d <- results_cl[[paste0("unmatched.", k)]]$data %>% mutate(panel = paste0("\"", lab_map[[as.character(k)]], "\" cluster"))
  cohort_model_panel(results_cl[[paste0("unmatched.", k)]])
})
# the facet strip needs the panel variable in the data: add it
for (k in seq_len(k_cl)) { m <- results_cl[[paste0("unmatched.", k)]]; m$data$panel <- paste0("\"", lab_map[[as.character(k)]], "\" cluster")
  p_cl[[k]] <- cohort_model_panel(m) }
save_panel(p_5b, 4, "Fig4b_mixed_model_all", 6, 5)
for (k in seq_len(k_cl)) save_panel(p_cl[[k]], 4, paste0("Fig4", letters[2 + k], "_mixed_model_cluster_", k), 6, 5)
p_5bc <- wrap_plots(c(list(p_5b), p_cl), nrow = 1) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_5bc
```

# 3. Summary statistics of the trajectories (unmatched set, 5 genes)

The figure shows the maximal VAF, the mean and maximal speed and the two ages; the SD of the speed and the statistics of
the acceleration are in Figure S15 (all statistics in every set: Figures S15-S18, Table S12).

```{r fig4stats, fig.width=15, fig.height=3.5}
sums <- map(sets, ~ set_summary(.x, ages))
panels_st <- c(max_VAF = "VAF (max)", mean_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (mean)", max_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (max)",
               Age_LoD2 = "Age at LoD/2", Age_0.02 = "Age at 2% VAF")
hlines <- c(max_VAF = chip_vaf, mean_VAF_speed = 0, max_VAF_speed = 0, mean_VAF_acceleration = 0, max_VAF_acceleration = 0)
stat_panels <- imap(panels_st, ~ cohort_box(sums$unmatched, .y, .x, if (.y %in% names(hlines)) hlines[[.y]] else NULL))
first_letter <- 2 + k_cl + 1
for (i in seq_along(stat_panels)) save_panel(stat_panels[[i]], 4, paste0("Fig4", letters[first_letter + i - 1], "_", names(panels_st)[i]), 3, 3.3)
p_5st <- wrap_plots(stat_panels, nrow = 1)
p_5st
```

```{r tests}
stat_groups <- list(
  VAF = c(mean_VAF = "VAF (mean)", min_VAF = "VAF (min)", max_VAF = "VAF (max)", sd_VAF = "VAF (sd)"),
  Speed = c(mean_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (mean)", min_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (min)", max_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (max)", sd_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (sd)"),
  Acceleration = c(mean_VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (mean)", min_VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (min)", max_VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (max)", sd_VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (sd)"),
  Age = c(mean_Age = "Age (mean)", min_Age = "Age (min)", max_Age = "Age (max)"),
  `Age at a VAF` = c(Age_LoD2 = "Age at LoD/2", Age_0.02 = "Age at 2% VAF"))
all_stats <- unlist(unname(stat_groups))
wilcox_row <- function(s, stat) {
  x <- s[[stat]][s$Cohort == "SHCS"]; y <- s[[stat]][s$Cohort == "SardiNIA"]
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]; y <- y[!is.na(y)]
  tibble(statistic = all_stats[[stat]], stat = stat, n_SHCS = length(x), n_SardiNIA = length(y), median_SHCS = median(x), median_SardiNIA = median(y),
         p = wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)$p.value)
}
tests <- imap_dfr(sums, ~ map_dfr(names(all_stats), function(st) wilcox_row(.x, st)) %>% mutate(set = set_labels[[.y]])) %>%
  group_by(set) %>% mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>% relocate(set)
write_res(tests, "fig4_cohort_wilcoxon_tests.txt")
tests %>% filter(set == "Unmatched") %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>% knitr::kable()
```

# 4. Figure 4 assembled

```{r fig4, fig.width=15, fig.height=13}
n_top <- 1 + k_cl   # a + b + the clusters are 2 + k_cl panels: a and b on the first row, the clusters on the second
row1 <- c(wrap_elements(full = p_5a), p_5b + theme(legend.position = "none"))
row2 <- map(p_cl, ~ .x + theme(legend.position = "none"))
p_top <- wrap_plots(row1, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1.2))
p_mid <- wrap_plots(row2, nrow = 1)
p_bot <- wrap_plots(stat_panels, nrow = 1)
p_5 <- (p_top / p_mid / p_bot) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 0.8)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & tag_theme
save_main(p_5, 4, "Figure4", 15, 13, svg = TRUE)
p_5
```

# 5. Supplementary figures

```{r figS-sets, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
set_grobs <- map(sets[-1], ~ margin_plot(.x))
for (i in seq_along(set_grobs)) for (e in c("png", "svg")) ggsave(file.path(paper$supp, "panels", paste0("FigS11_matching_sets_", letters[i], "_", names(sets)[-1][i], ".", e)), set_grobs[[i]], width = 5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p_sets <- wrap_plots(map(set_grobs, ~ wrap_elements(full = .x)), nrow = 1) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & tag_theme

p_sets
```

## 5.2 Mixed models in the other sets, with the interaction, and by gene

```{r figS-mm, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
strip_panel <- function(m, label) { m$data$panel <- label; cohort_model_panel(m) }
p_s_sets_list <- map(set_keys[-1], ~ strip_panel(results[[paste0(.x, ".All.slope.zero")]], set_labels[[.x]]))
for (i in seq_along(p_s_sets_list)) save_panel(p_s_sets_list[[i]], "supp", paste0("FigS12_mixed_models_sets_", letters[i]), 5, 5)
p_s_sets <- wrap_plots(p_s_sets_list, nrow = 1) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & theme(legend.position = "bottom") & tag_theme
save_supp(p_s_sets, "FigS12_mixed_models_sets", 14, 5)
p_s_sets
p_s_int_list <- map(set_keys, ~ strip_panel(results[[paste0(.x, ".All.slope.")]], set_labels[[.x]]))
for (i in seq_along(p_s_int_list)) save_panel(p_s_int_list[[i]], "supp", paste0("FigS13_mixed_models_interaction_", letters[i]), 5, 5)
p_s_int <- wrap_plots(p_s_int_list, nrow = 2) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & theme(legend.position = "bottom") & tag_theme
save_supp(p_s_int, "FigS13_mixed_models_interaction", 12, 10)
p_s_gene_list <- map(main_genes, ~ strip_panel(results[[paste0("unmatched.", .x, ".slope.zero")]], .x) + theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic")))
for (i in seq_along(p_s_gene_list)) save_panel(p_s_gene_list[[i]], "supp", paste0("FigS14_mixed_models_by_gene_", letters[i], "_", main_genes[i]), 5, 5)
p_s_gene <- wrap_plots(p_s_gene_list, nrow = 2) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & theme(legend.position = "bottom") & tag_theme
save_supp(p_s_gene, "FigS14_mixed_models_by_gene", 14, 10)
```

## 5.3 Summary statistics in every set

```{r figS-stats, fig.width=11, fig.height=13}
set_figure <- function(s) {
  rows <- map(stat_groups, function(st) wrap_plots(imap(st, ~ cohort_box(s, .y, .x, if (.y %in% names(hlines)) hlines[[.y]] else NULL, size = 12)), nrow = 1, ncol = 4))
  wrap_plots(rows, ncol = 1) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & tag_theme
}
# Figures S15-S18, in the order of set_keys (unmatched, unmatched_filtered, matched, matched_filtered)
for (i in seq_along(set_keys)) save_supp(set_figure(sums[[set_keys[i]]]), paste0("FigS", 14 + i, "_summary_statistics_", set_keys[i]), 11, 13)
set_figure(sums$unmatched)
```
